note: Fake DOM/RAF with actual browser-global motion/playback/renderer and ImageData shim. Does not certify browser visuals, CSS layout, native form validation, performance, BFCache delivery ordering, or assistive-technology behavior.

results.name: HTML load order exposes all globals; shared body and duration bounds are compatible
Autoplay, repeated pause/play/replay, keyboard and speed maintain one RAF chain
Hidden pages freeze across repeated interruptions and preserve pause intent
Reduced-motion first load and dynamic changes stay static until explicit play
Invalid time, seed, and gravity submissions are atomic; valid apply repeats pixels
Empty numeric seed is rejected without replacing simulation
Pagehide cancels scheduling; repeated pageshow resumes once and refreshed size renders
Legacy media/resize fallback and repeated viewport changes retain RAF invariant
Duration endpoint renders within body bound and wraps with one active chain
